clauses.text: Eligibility criteria, instructions and other details are available in the Prospectus of UGMAC-2026 which can be downloaded from the Board’s website bceceboard.bihar.gov.in by clicking on the link “UGMAC-2026” under Prospectus Section
* For Eligibility Criteria and other details, required Documents for admission on NRI Quota, candidates are advised to see ‘Notice to Candidates Admission Procedure under NRI Quota issued by MCC dt

* For Eligibility Criteria and other details, required Documents for admission on (DQ) Quota, candidates are advised to see ‘Chapter 4: Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) of Information Bulleting & Counselling Scheme of NEET(UG) Counselling 2026’ which can be seen on MCC Official Website
